summary: Top navigation: the pack's pill stops plus search, profile and gear. Home, Movies and Series are always there; Games and Live TV are doors the host draws only when the household installed the add-on behind them.

items.description: Nav destinations: label, icon and route.

variant.description: Apple/Glass centred pill, Kids brand-disc capsule, or the classic wordmark bar.

active.description: Route currently standing; never inferred from geometry.

showsLive.description: Draw the Live TV stop only when the household's hub carries the live add-on and a playlist. The host decides; the theme never guesses from a row.

showsGames.description: Draw the Games stop only when an enabled add-on declares the games resource.

compact.description: Icon-only form for narrow profile and gear stops.

profile.description: Current household member: name, initials and avatar URL.
